name: Ardicino della Porta, iuniore
summary:
Ardicino della Porta the Younger (1434–1493) was an Italian Roman Catholic bishop and cardinal who played a significant role in the Renaissance humanist movement. As Archbishop of Bologna, he worked closely with prominent figures such as Lorenzo de' Medici and Pius II to promote education and the arts.

Della Porta's legacy extends beyond his own lifetime, influencing the development of Catholic theology and the rise of Protestantism during the Reformation. His diplomatic efforts helped to establish trade relationships between Italy and other European countries, contributing to the growth of the Renaissance economy.

Despite his passing in 1493, della Porta's contributions remain relevant today, offering insights into the complex web of alliances and rivalries that shaped medieval Europe.
